heading:
A natural operating sequence:
inputs → settings → search → timetable
visibleText:
26
PART VII — A DAILY OPERATOR RUN
A natural operating sequence:
inputs → settings → search → timetable

The operator starts from a reference schedule, reviews a recommendation, and carries the selected plan into the next cycle.

01 · Import planning inputs

Load films, screens, operating rules and the reference timetable into one planning workspace.

02 · Set the planning goal

Choose the audience objective, available operating window and search budget.

03 · Run feasible search

Evaluate candidate film allocations and showtimes while respecting screen and timing constraints.

04 · Inspect the recommendation

Compare expected audiences, screen utilization and changed time slots with the reference.

05 · Review and export

Keep the selected plan, record operator edits and export the timetable for publication.

06 · Learn and replan

Return booking and attendance outcomes to the models and update eligible future screenings.

Operator workflow · Import → configure → optimize → inspect → publish → update
